summary.title: HUNT-LITE Security Architecture and Threat Model
summary.description: HUNT-LITE is a local Streamlit-based cybersecurity education and triage application that accepts built-in or user-uploaded CSV telemetry, validates and normalizes required fields, preprocesses security records, executes a frozen Keras classification model, applies deterministic triage logic, and presents analyst-oriented review and reporting functions. Guidance is provided through a deterministic Local Coach and an optional OpenAI Coach using a user-supplied or locally configured API key. User-controlled telemetry is treated as untrusted input, model and configuration assets remain local, and external communication is limited to the optional OpenAI API path. This threat model focuses on the trust boundaries and security controls relevant to potential public-network deployment.

diagrams.title: HUNT-LITE Architecture and Trust Boundaries

data.name: TB1 - HUNT-LITE Local Application Boundary
data.description: Separates user-controlled input and external systems from trusted local HUNT-LITE execution. Uploaded or selected telemetry is treated as untrusted until validation and schema mapping succeed.

data.name:
TB2 — External
OpenAI Service
Boundary
data.description: Separates local HUNT-LITE execution from the optional external OpenAI service. Communication crosses the public network only when the OpenAI Coach is used.

data.name: User / Analyst
data.description: Human user who selects built-in telemetry or uploads CSV data, reviews triage results and alerts, requests analyst guidance, generates reports, and may optionally provide a session API key.

data.name:
Streamlit
UI
data.description: Local user interface for selecting or uploading telemetry, initiating analysis, reviewing alerts and records, requesting coaching, and viewing generated reports.

data.name:
Input
Validation &
Schema
Mapping
data.description: Fail-closed validation layer for uploaded telemetry. Enforces CSV parsing requirements, the required six-field schema or controlled schema mapping, semantic validation, and normalization before records reach the ML pipeline.

data.name:
ML
Preprocessing
data.description: Transforms validated and normalized telemetry into the encoded feature representation expected by the trained machine-learning model.

data.name: Model / ML Artifacts
data.description: Local static machine-learning assets used for inference, including preprocessing artifacts, label mapping or encoder information, and the frozen trained Keras model.

data.name:
Frozen
Keras
Model
data.description: Runtime inference component that loads the trained model and produces classification scores or predictions from preprocessed telemetry. The model is used for assessment and prioritization rather than proof of compromise.

data.name:
Triage
Engine
data.description: Combines model output with deterministic triage logic to assign prediction, confidence, severity, and review-queue information used by the analyst workflow.

data.name:
Local
Coach
data.description: Deterministic local guidance component that provides analyst-oriented explanation and investigation guidance without sending telemetry to an external service.

data.name:
OpenAI
Coach
data.description: Optional local client that constructs a controlled prompt from selected telemetry and triage context, obtains an API credential from the permitted session or local configuration source, and communicates with the external OpenAI API.

data.name:
Local Credential /
Configuration
data.description: Optional local configuration source for OPENAI_API_KEY and OpenAI model settings. Repository-distributed files do not contain real credentials. A session-entered API key is transient and is not part of telemetry.

data.name:
Report Engine /
Analyst Notes
data.description: Generates analyst-oriented notes, incident summaries, and reporting output from analyzed records and available investigation context.

data.name:
OpenAI
API
data.description: Optional external AI service used by the OpenAI Coach. Receives a controlled prompt containing selected telemetry and contextual information and returns explanatory output.
